note: The arcade as bodies in space (MAIL 1010, MAIL 1029 point 2 and 3). Lengths are stage units (the ball's radius is terrain.json radius), angles degrees, speeds stage units a second along the strand. Every strand is a fixed line; what moves is the plasma along it, at one steady speed for each strand. least: the half width of a strand's tube, in pixels of the master's frame, under which it is no line any more. thin: over this range of a tube's true half width against least (0.45 down to 0.15) its light goes from the line of a tube to one soft bell over its whole band, with the same sum across in linear light. band: the least half width in pixels of the whole band a strand is drawn with, tube and sheath together; a band that would be narrower keeps that width and its light falls by the same share. The least belongs to the band and not to the tube, so a wider sheath does not widen what a far strand is drawn with. along: the pattern of the plasma along a strand goes to its own mean over this range of its steps under one pixel (0.25: four pixels to a step, 1: one), the sparks by their own finer steps, so a far strand gives the same light and does not glitter. light sheath: how many times the tube's width the thin sheath around it is wide, and its light against the most the tube's own gas gives there (never more than light most). light cool and hot: the colour of a faint and of a bright strand as the finished frame shows it, in linear light. leave lines and px (MAIL 1421): the arcade gives its whole light while it stands at least px[1] rows tall in a frame of lines rows, and none under px[0]; between them its share is a smooth step in the logarithm of that size, one law of the distance at every frame. Measured in the set (rows of 2160): 637 at frame 0 and more through the close view, 502 at 203, 393 at 210, 307 at 216, 245 at 221, 167 at 229, 137 at 233, 109 at 238, 64 at the hold. Its loops can be told apart down to about 150 rows (frame 231); from about 120 (frame 236) the body is a haze with a few soft dots. So it is whole in the close view and up to frame 208, falls over the 25 frames after and gives nothing from frame 233 on, at the hold and in the travel. leave under: where the ball is not in the depth buffer (the far Sun draws the arcade in a pass without depth) a strand behind a ball this far under the true radius, as the eye sees it, gives no light. main unlike: the ten bundles are of unlike size, a strand takes bundle floor(x to this power times 10) for x from 0 to 1. main spread wide: a bundle is as wide as spread times this, the largest bundle the first value, the smallest the second. main loose: a strand of no bundle has this share of the radius and of the light.
